items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Sid Zieler’s got a job, he’s doing a job Friday night and he needs a piano player.

ctx.x: No I know that. The club dates, and they’d say okay this is an anniversary party or something?
Well we wouldn’t know what kind of party it was, it would just be like Sid Zieler’s got a job, he’s doing a job Friday night and he needs a piano player.
